scenario: I and five other people are trapped in a burning building. There is only one emergency exit through which all of us could escape, but it is blocked by burning debris. Another injured person is about to crawl through a hole at the bottom of the exit door. I and the five people behind me do not have time to do the same. If I use the injured person to break down the debris I will be able to escape. Doing this will certainly kill him, but it will save me and the five people behind me.
entities: i,the injured person at the exit
outcomes: The injured person escapes through the hole
The emergency exit remains blocked by burning debris
I remain trapped in the burning building
